verdict.rationale: Evidence covers on-call schedules, escalation policies, Slack/Signals alerting, and Slack-based interactions (/fh commands), but there is no mention anywhere of a native mobile app for iOS/Android, nor any description of acknowledging/escalating/resolving incidents from a phone.
